استعرفوا (form X)
# اِسْتَعْرَفُوا (istaʕrafū) /is.taʕ.ra.fuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَعْرَفَ (istaʕrafa)
# اُسْتُعْرِفُوا (ustuʕrifū) /us.tuʕ.ri.fuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَعْرَفَ (istaʕrafa)
# اِسْتَعْرِفُوا (istaʕrifū) /is.taʕ.ri.fuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَعْرَفَ (istaʕrafa)
